display.purpose: The person's name. Clash Display 700, effective clamp(48px, 7.2vw, 94px) after the later override block. Deliberately larger than the h1 beneath it.

headline.purpose: The promise statement in the hero. Clash Display 600, clamp(30px, 4.2vw, 58px), set in --ink-2 rather than --ink so it recedes under the name.

section-title.purpose: About and Contact headings. Clash Display 700, clamp(36px, 4.5vw, 58px) with -0.035em tracking.

title.purpose: Project, certificate, honor, and role names inside cards. Clash Display 600 at fixed 15-19px.

body.purpose: Prose in About, Contact, and modals. Satoshi 16px / 1.82. Measure is capped by container width, not by a ch value.

label.purpose: Every dated, counted, or named fact: section ordinals, dates, credential IDs, tags, statuses. JetBrains Mono 11px / 0.08em uppercase. 11px is the enforced floor after the contrast-override block; mobile steps to 12px.

shadows.name: sh-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation of nested surfaces (.stack-card, .pg-shell, .about-kpi, .exp-logo-slot) and hover lift on small controls. Never on a card at rest.

shadows.name: sh-md
shadows.purpose: Hover on .exp-card and .cert-card, plus the .exp-card.open state.

shadows.name: sh-lg
shadows.purpose: Hover on .proj-card (paired with translateY(-6px)) and the resting .modal-box.

shadows.name: ad-hoc-hero-ring
shadows.purpose: .hero-profile-ring. The only decorative shadow in the system. Not tokenized.

shadows.name: ad-hoc-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input :focus alongside the gold outline. Not tokenized.

motion.name: ease-s
motion.purpose: The workhorse easing. ~40 var(--ease-s) references: all reveals, hovers, the accordion, the drawer, and every *In keyframe. Declared as --ease-s.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Declared in :root with an overshoot past 1. Currently UNUSED - zero var(--ease) references. Either wire it up or delete it.

motion.name: ease-i
motion.purpose: Declared in :root. Currently UNUSED - zero var(--ease-i) references. Either wire it up or delete it.

motion.name: wordUp
motion.purpose: Masked per-word rise of the hero h1. 1s per word, .05s / .18s / .31s ladder.

motion.name: fadeSlide
motion.purpose: Every hero paragraph and CTA row. .7s, with explicit per-element delays .55s .7s .85s .92s 1s 1.1s 1.3s.

motion.name: floatCircle
motion.purpose: .hero-circle gold radial glow. 8s ease-in-out infinite alternate.

motion.name: profileOrbit
motion.purpose: .hero-profile-ring drift. 6.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate. Listed in the reduced-motion override.

motion.name: nudge
motion.purpose: The inline SVG arrow inside the modal flow diagram. 2s infinite. Listed in the reduced-motion override.

motion.name: reveal-on-scroll
motion.purpose: [data-reveal] triggered by an IntersectionObserver (threshold .1, rootMargin 0 0 -48px) that adds .in then unobserves. Direction variants: left -40px, right 40px, scale .94.

motion.name: stagger-ladder
motion.purpose: [data-delay="1"] through [data-delay="6"] - six slots, claimed in DOM order by grid children. Chip grids reuse the slots cyclically instead of continuing the count.

breakpoints.name: site-tablet
breakpoints.scope: site-wide; declared twice (base + overrides) plus a third for .pg-* at :1695

breakpoints.name: site-phone
breakpoints.scope: site-wide; declared three times (:819, :1425, :1702) plus a fourth micro-type block at :1705

breakpoints.name: reduced-motion
breakpoints.scope: global - collapses all durations and nulls transform/animation on .grid-bg, .hero-circle, .proj-card, .flow-arrow-svg svg

container.note: Applied as section { max-width: 1160px } with box-sizing: border-box, so 48px gutters are inside the 1160px. #hero opts out via .hero-section { max-width: none } and centers an inner .hero-shell at the same 1160px.

layoutTokens.note: There is NO spacing scale. Only --hero-media-inset (16px) is tokenized. Rhythm comes from section padding (112px 48px -> 80px 24px -> 68px 18px), three gap tiers (64-80px between major halves, 16-20px between cards, 6-12px inline), and card padding (20 / 24 / 26 / 32px).

radiusScale.note: Two-step radius split is load-bearing: 2px for rectangular action controls, 999px for chips/pills. Never invert them.

narrative.overview:
A single-page portfolio presented as a warm, paper-toned engineering dossier. The visual argument is that the work speaks for itself: a near-monochrome ink-on-paper base carries almost the entire page, hairline rules and a faint 64px grid establish structure, and a single muted gold (#b8924a) is spent on exactly one job per component — a leading rule, a hover accent, an issuer name, a focus ring. Nothing glows for decoration. The one moment of real depth is the hero portrait, where a translucent gold-tinted plate floats behind an inset white-framed photograph.

Two systems do most of the work. Clash Display carries identity — large, tightly-tracked (down to -0.05em), often set at line-height below 1 so headline blocks read as solid slabs. JetBrains Mono carries instrumentation — every label, section number, date, credential ID, tag, and status chip is monospaced, small, and letterspaced, so metadata is visually separable from prose at a glance without needing a different container. Satoshi sits between them for everything readable.

Motion is quiet and one-directional: content rises into place on a single fast-out easing, cards lift a few pixels on hover, and the decorative layers (grid, gold orb, portrait plate) drift slowly on long alternate loops. A custom pointer, a scroll-linked grid parallax, and a film-grain noise overlay supply texture rather than interaction.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white paper (#f8f7f4) base; dark ink is the only contrast, gold is the only accent.
Every piece of metadata is monospaced and letterspaced — a hard typographic split between "what I said" and "about the thing."
Borders are 1.5px --line on cards and controls; hover swaps them to --ink, never to gold.
Generous vertical rhythm (112px section padding) with no spacing scale — raw px everywhere.
Decorative motion runs on 2s–8s alternate loops; content motion is 0.15s–1s and fires once.

rules.name: The Restrained Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold marks structure, never decoration. One gold element per component: a leading 28×1px rule, one hover border, one issuer line, one focus ring. If a new component would use gold for a second purpose inside the same block, it should use --ink instead.

rules.name: The Ink Hover Rule
rules.body: Hovering an interactive element swaps its border to --ink (and often its background to --ink with #fff text). Gold appears in hover only where the element has no border to recolor — .proj-cta text, the honor timeline dot.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: --ink-4 (#b0ada8) is not legible enough for small text. A late override block in style.css (the "Increase micro typography readability and contrast" section) raises 21 metadata selectors to 11px / 0.08em and repaints 12 of them to #6f6b66. Any new metadata label should start at 11px / --ink-3 or darker, not copy the older 10px / --ink-4 pattern.

rules.name: The Metadata Is Mono Rule
rules.body: If it can be dated, counted, named, or labelled, it is JetBrains Mono, uppercase, letterspaced. Never set a fact in Clash Display at body size.

rules.name: The Reversed Hero Rule
rules.body: The name renders first and largest; the h1 beneath it is the smaller, lighter, lower-contrast statement. Do not "fix" this hierarchy by promoting the h1 above .hero-nickname — the current order is the design.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No card has a shadow until hovered or opened. If you add a shadow to a resting surface, you are adding elevation the layout hasn't earned.

dos: Do spend gold on one thing per component — a leading rule, a hover border, an issuer line, a focus ring — and reach for --ink for anything structural.
Do set every fact (dates, counts, IDs, tags, statuses, section ordinals) in JetBrains Mono, uppercase, 11px / 0.08em or darker.
Do keep cards flat at rest (1.5px solid var(--line), no shadow) and add --sh-md or --sh-lg only on hover or open.
Do animate only opacity and transform, with .2s–.8s and var(--ease-s); use .in-class triggers for scroll reveals.
Do reuse the data-delay="1"–"6" ladder (100ms steps) for grid staggers and claim slots in DOM order.
Do use the ratio token — set --hero-media-ar and let aspect-ratio derive the layout — rather than hard-coding a height.
Do give new images explicit width/height and an onerror placeholder fallback.
Do test at 1023px and 1024px. That pair is where the hero switches between two distinct layouts.
donts: Don't give the .hero-profile-ring an offset transform or negative inset. It must stay inset: 0; the --hero-media-inset gap comes from shrinking .hero-profile-frame to calc(100% - var(--hero-media-inset)). Any other approach overflows the grid cell.
Don't add a new loop or end-state-dependent animation without listing it in the prefers-reduced-motion override block.
Don't set small text in --ink-4 (#b0ada8). Use #6f6b66 or --ink-3; the late contrast-override block exists because this was already a problem once.
Don't add a spacing scale, a Tailwind config, a preprocessor, or a build step. Raw px in style.css is the convention; section padding plus grid gaps is the rhythm.
Don't promote the h1 above .hero-nickname or enlarge it — the name-first hierarchy is deliberate.
Don't use a rounded pill shape for rectangular action buttons (2px) or a sharp corner for chips (999px). The two-step radius split is load-bearing.
Don't invent a new gold shade. Extend the tinted-chip pattern with explicit hex triples if a new category needs color.
Don't assume a declared --ease* token is used; verify with var(--ease) / var(--ease-i) before building on it.
